name: portfolio_policy-hold-vs-redeploy
notes: ADR-0279 Stages 1-4 on aggregate positions: the latest schwab_positions snapshot -> liquidation tax per holding -> hold vs redeploy decision -> rows written. Every rate, horizon, premium and field name is a value of THIS document; the kinds carry none. The as_of, rates and returns below are placeholders the owner sets before the first real run; they are the experiment's identity, so changing them changes the hash on purpose.

positions.notes: Role 'data': the deduplicated positions snapshot acquired through dskit.onboarding (connector schwab_positions). One row per account x symbol x day; latest acquisition wins.

tax.notes: Aggregate rows carry no acquisition date, so every holding takes default_holding until a lot-level source adds an 'acquired' field (then declare acquired_field). Rates are the owner's marginal federal + NIIT placeholders; state tax is not included.

market.notes: Role 'data': the market's expected nominal return from four public numbers (research A0001): S&P 500 dividend yield, long-run real earnings growth, expected inflation, and the drift from today's Shiller CAPE toward a fair CAPE over reversion_years. Placeholders; the owner refreshes them from public data before each real run.

betas.notes: risk_free + beta x (market - risk_free) per symbol. betas is the owner's table (a 5-year monthly beta from any public source); a holding missing from it refuses, on purpose: no default_beta here, so a new position cannot be silently priced as the market.

decide.notes: hold_return comes wired from $betas.rates (no hold_return param, so nothing can be pasted). redeploy_return is Stage 3's active hurdle, to be sourced from a child's scored backtest and haircut for selection (deflated Sharpe), never a hope; risk_premium carries that haircut until a child reports a deflated figure.

params.source: hold-vs-redeploy decisions per account x symbol

decisions.notes: Role 'report': the advisory rows, one per holding, with liq_* and the decision, in ./decisions under the invoking cwd, one file per run so no run shadows another (ADR-0247). Never an order.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Placement is not identity.
